topics.title: Plants
topics.description: Discover the world of plants around us!

lessons.title: Types of Plants
lessons.hook: Did you know plants come in many different sizes? Some are tiny, some are HUGE! 🌳
lessons.explanation: Plants can be very big or very small. We divide them into different groups based on their size and the type of stem they have. Let's explore!
lessons.content:
There are 5 main types of plants:

1. **Trees** - Very big and tall with hard, brown stems called trunks. They live for many years!
2. **Shrubs** - Medium-sized plants with strong woody stems
3. **Herbs** - Small plants with soft green stems
4. **Climbers** - Weak plants that need support to grow up
5. **Creepers** - Weak plants that grow along the ground

examples.title: Trees 🌳
examples.description: Big, tall plants like neem, banyan, mango, and coconut trees
examples.visual: Tree with brown trunk and green leaves

examples.title: Shrubs 🌸
examples.description: Medium-sized like rose, sunflower, cotton, and hibiscus

examples.title: Herbs 🌱
examples.description: Small plants like spinach, mint, and coriander - some we eat!

examples.title: Climbers 🏃
examples.description: Weak plants that climb like money plant and grapevine

examples.title: Creepers 🎃
examples.description: Spread on ground like pumpkin and watermelon

lessons.title: Parts of a Plant
lessons.hook: Every plant is like a small factory with special parts that do different jobs! 🏭
lessons.explanation: Plants have many parts, and each part has an important job to help the plant grow and survive.
lessons.content:
The main parts of a plant are:

1. **Root** 📍 - Holds plant in soil, absorbs water and minerals
2. **Stem** 🌿 - Carries water and food to all parts, supports the plant
3. **Leaf** 🍃 - Makes food for the plant using air, water, and sunlight
4. **Flower** 💐 - Produces fruits and seeds
5. **Fruit** 🍎 - Contains seeds that grow into new plants

examples.title: Root - Underground Workers 📍
examples.description: Roots drink water from soil and keep plant standing tall
examples.food_example: Carrot, radish, turnip - we eat roots!

examples.title: Stem - The Delivery System 🌿
examples.description: Stems carry water from roots to leaves and food from leaves to roots

examples.title: Leaf - The Kitchen 🍃
examples.description: Leaves make food for plants using sunlight. It's like a plant's kitchen!

examples.title: Flower - The Fruit Maker 💐
examples.description: Flowers are beautiful and they make fruits and seeds

examples.title: Fruit - Seed Container 🍎
examples.description: Fruits protect seeds inside. When seeds fall, new plants grow!
examples.food_example: Apple, mango, cherry - we eat fruits!

lessons.title: Things We Get From Plants
lessons.hook: Plants give us SO many things we use every day! Let's discover them! 🎁
lessons.explanation: Plants are super useful! They give us food, clothes, medicine, and many other things we need.
lessons.content:
We get many important things from plants:

**Food**: Rice, wheat, vegetables, fruits, spices
**Clothes**: Cotton, jute, linen
**Medicine**: Tulsi, neem, clove
**Other things**: Wood, oil, rubber, paper, perfume, soap

Plants also give us oxygen to breathe!

questions.question: Which of these is a TREE?
questions.hint: Think of the biggest plants. Which one grows very tall and lives for many years?
questions.explanation: Neem is a tree! It's big, tall, and has a hard trunk. Mint is a herb, rose is a shrub, and pumpkin is a creeper.

questions.question: What does a ROOT do?
questions.hint: Roots are underground. What do they drink?
questions.explanation: Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil! They also hold the plant firmly in the ground.

questions.question: We eat the STEM of which plant?
questions.hint: Think about what you eat as a vegetable that grows underground but isn't a root.
questions.explanation: Potato is a stem! It grows underground and we eat it. A carrot is a root, spinach is a leaf, and apple is a fruit.

questions.question: Which plant needs a STICK to grow up?
questions.hint: Some plants have weak stems and need help to climb up.
questions.explanation: Money plant is a climber! It has a weak stem and uses a stick or wall to climb up. Pumpkin is a creeper that spreads on the ground.

questions.question: We wear clothes made from COTTON. Cotton comes from...
questions.hint: Cotton is a soft, fluffy fiber. It surrounds the seeds. What part of the plant has this?
questions.explanation: Cotton comes from the flower! The fluffy cotton fibers surround the seeds inside the flower. These are spun into thread to make clothes.
